products.name: Aleph Alpha
products.note: European sovereign LLM; EU-hosted; GDPR-first; multilingual; Luminous model family

profile_text.body:
Aleph Alpha is a European AI company that develops specialized language models and AI solutions for businesses and public institutions in Europe. The company describes itself as focused on sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure, and its products are EU-hosted and multilingual. Its core offering is the Luminous model family, positioned as a European alternative for enterprise and government use cases.

The company's site highlights several applied deployments. A government agency AI assistant is described as serving 80,000 users and accelerating administrative processes. An AI agent deployed for a global chip manufacturer to extract verified insights from sensitive documents is said to have reduced search times by 90 percent. A requirements engineering deployment for an automotive supplier is described as producing 40 percent faster RFQ processing.

The held facts record Aleph Alpha as a tracked product in the Chat and General LLMs category, with its sovereign European positioning and GDPR-first approach noted. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
